name: Chicken Chimichangas
subtitle: Crisp tortillas filled with seasoned chicken, peppers, beans, and cheese
description: Chicken, vegetables, green chillies, and cheese are wrapped in tortillas with optional refried beans, then baked or fried and served with enchilada sauce and garnishes.

ingredients.item: vegetable oil plus 60ml (if frying rather than baking)
skinless and boneless chicken thigh fillets
Monterey Jack cheese grated plus extra for serving
soured cream and a handful of chopped coriander

instructions.text: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken and half of the chopped green chillies until the chicken reaches 165°F internally, about 8 minutes. If using leftover cooked chicken, warm it through instead.
Add the onion and red pepper; cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in the garlic powder, cumin, and chipotle chilli powder.
Shred or chop the chicken and combine it with the vegetables, remaining green chillies, and 85 g Monterey Jack.
Warm the tortillas until pliable. Spread optional refried beans over each tortilla, add the chicken mixture, and fold in the sides and roll tightly.
For baking, heat the oven to 400°F and arrange the chimichangas seam-side down on a baking sheet. Brush with the cooking oil and bake for about 25 minutes, turning once if needed, until crisp.
For frying instead, heat the remaining 60 ml oil in a skillet and fry the chimichangas seam-side down, turning as needed, until crisp and hot throughout.
Serve with red enchilada sauce, extra Monterey Jack, soured cream, and chopped coriander.
